# Informed parameter-declaration preparation

Prepared before source checking. Codex read the current Reference, parser,
finite signature/profile path, sized source projection/declaration path,
shared source collection and preceding authoring record. No external model was
invoked; the exact deployed model identifier and sampling settings are unknown.
This is informed repository work, not an independent blind authoring benchmark.

The [local candidate](../../../../tests/fixtures/frontend_v030/common-parameter-declaration-design/candidate-01.md)
describes possible extraction of existing source-spelling claims and iterative
runtime name traversal. It is non-normative. The current rules require unique
names, exact tuple/Unit shape, ordered static kinds and complete checking of
unused declarations. Finite and sized stages and diagnostics remain distinct.
Moving a checker helper does not promote its output to native acceptance.

The observed Git HEAD during preparation is
`7e2bf08cb2a9367e1d5fefe8ced451c3e6f57149`. It identifies a source-history
baseline only. Current file hashes separately bind working-tree bytes; the
study makes no claim that this commit, source map and selected prebuilt CLI
have been independently joined by a build attestation.

The CLI SHA-256 was read from its actual bytes and matched root's supplied
`4a5cc9e753268fd7b0b4972cf84dd1fd6338218bc0b104d71b8465fab89151cf`.
The selected native binary is unchanged, SHA-256
`39effde0f152a2c926fcea3a7f99fc2f25f9de65906be2b8c527508353c90c85`.
Neither executable was invoked during preparation. Python only read files,
prepared these records and ran the mandatory constitutional startup guard.

That [actual startup guard](preparation/constitution.json) passed continuity
against `faa5cfb5e7ea1cf3b39a43b80f7f2345e89197c2`. Adopted QS-2026-01,
PR-2026-01, RS-2026-01 and EXACT-2026-01 apply; their broader proof/enforcement
obligations remain pending. The two ordinary QLV1 ownership/scope guarantees
retain every admitted scope, premise and exclusion. This is source/evidence
identity checking, not fresh Lean replay, human adoption or proof discharge.

All concrete study interfaces contain at most two physical qubits. The forward
kind counterexample uses an unused Op<Bits<n>> with the premise n <= 2; it
requests no specialization or family execution. Finite project preparation
still visits the existing bundled stdlib, including its prior four-bit body;
no new large source/system is generated or executed by this study.
The separate symbolic type-order counterexample has the feasible premise
n == 0 and a deliberately invalid n - 1 type. It checks rejection order only;
no invalid-width system is instantiated or executed.

No source repair is planned. Deliberate errors are counterexamples, and the
valid nested project is only an intended checking control. If any source needs
repair, preserve this complete first attempt and add a separate full attempt
with its actual reason. Check-only observations supply no phase/reference,
runtime, quantitative-resource or source-preservation oracle.

Two real wrong-path read probes are retained as transcripts under preparation;
they are not CLI results, fabricated exits or source repairs. Subsequent reads
used the actual discovered implementation paths.
